args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: After deploying checkout-api v2.3.1 to production (us-east, us-west, eu-west), the service failed health checks with an error rate of 18%. (The v2.3.1-rc staging build had also been marked unhealthy.) checkout-api was rolled back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service reports healthy, and the error rate is 0.2%. Follow-up: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying it.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened a SEV2 incident, which paged the on-call engineer.

- **Problem:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west, was failing health checks and had an 18% error rate. The test build of this release (v2.3.1-rc) had also been marked unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. I rolled back to it in all three regions. Afterward, every region is on v2.3.0, the service reports healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001, titled "checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0". It describes the failure, the rollback and the result, and adds a follow-up: find why v2.3.1 failed before deploying it again.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
